meta.title: Web search router
meta.description: Routes the built-in web_search and web_fetch tools across AnySearch, Keenable, Exa, Tavily, Firecrawl, Zhihu, AIHOT, and direct HTTP. Quality mode merges free providers and reranks with BGE; keys are read from DSH credentials. Configure keys, providers, and modes in Settings > Search and fetch settings, or Plugins > Installed plugins > Web search router > Configuration.
